questions.question:

questions.solution:

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate indirect form of the given sentence.

He said to the grocer, "What is the price of tomatoes?"

options.text: He asked the grocer what was the price of tomatoes.
He asked the grocer that what was the price of tomatoes.
He asked the grocer what is the price of tomatoes.
He asked the grocer what the price of tomatoes was.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 4.

In indirect speech we always write sentence in assertive form.

**Sub + verb + object.**

In the given option only 4 has this construction of the sentence.

So, this will be the answer.

questions.question:
Identify the segment of the sentence, which contains the grammatical error, If there is no error mark "No Error".

No sooner did the (A)/ comedian begin his act (B)/ when the audience roared with laughter. (C)/ No error (D)
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** option 3 i.e. C**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e97c856a86e7f9a2254b6d21594beffe8b2a2afbb0c5bd00cd60b251c8f9881c.png] Explanation:

__
 
• Some conjunctions such as: ';** No sooner...than**', '**Hardly/scarcely...when**', are used in a pair. No sooner............ than is **coordinating conjunction** and both occur together. 
 
• For example :
 
 
• Hardly had I left the cinema hall than I saw the actor himself. * [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b91b169c9a6aba309887b5e1410c56688829831001bc1448ed23f1bec5eca1d8.png] *
 
• Hardly had I left the cinema hall when I saw the actor himself. * [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69a779acc017790d2eea790cc9122762921b180090c4a6901b9133fe30db56bd.png] * ​​
 
 
 
• Hence in the 3rd part of the sentence, 'than' will be used instead of 'when'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53c04207879a25f2d797ba9b51141a9644344e291894960f97f7453f00b5b693.png] 

 
• Whenever 'did' is used as an auxiliary/helping verb, the main verb will be** in 1st form.**
 
• In case of these conjunctions, an inverted form of the verb will be used as illustrated in the examples above.

 ​

Correct Sentence:__ *No sooner did the comedian begin his act **than **the audience roared with laughter.*

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate passive form of the given sentence.

They were distributing food grains among the poor.

options.text: Food grains were distributed among the poor.
The poor will be distributed among food grains.
Food grains were being distributed among the poor.
Food grains will be distributed among the poor.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 3.

**Active - Sub + were/was + v4 + object + other words.**

**Passive- Object + were/was + being + v3 + By + subject + other words.**

This structure is being followed by option 3.

So, the chosen option is correct.
